scope: Original slanted narrowing corridor only; change the top opening, keeping wall thickness, lower endpoints, robot model, endpoints and success thresholds unchanged.
actors: All six final recommended full-recipe actors; train seed2 final500 and seed3 final300, trained at 1.2m. No retraining or checkpoint selection.
acceptance: Collision-free final goal/formation/stop/dwell AND every robot crosses the actual opening. Independent float64 swept collision oracle each step.
selection: Report every actor and width; do not select checkpoints or adjust thresholds using this test.
